thesis: TMO sits within 0.5% of its 52-week high and is up ~18.3% over 60 days. thesis: LITE is up ~36.3% over 60 days on an AI-optics growth narrative: Citi raised its price target from $1,200 to $1,400 (Buy) citing a multi-year optical circuit switch opportunity, and the company disclosed a Qualcomm/Corning collaboration on a high-density optical interconnect for AI scale-up systems. invalidation: A stall in AI-optics design wins, or a walk-back of the Qualcomm/Corning collaboration timeline, would undercut the narrative supporting the rally.

thesis: TJX is down ~14.9% over 60 days, triggered by the Aug 19 fiscal Q3 guidance disappointment (Marmaxx comps of just 1%) that drove a ~19% slide from the June peak. invalidation: A reversal of the September guidance raise, or Q3 comps confirming Marmaxx softness persists, would invalidate this recovery read.
